title: Grand Theft Auto VI set for November 19, 2026
summary: Rockstar's Newswire says Grand Theft Auto VI will now release on Thursday, November 19, 2026.

title: Pre-orders, pricing, and November 12 pre-load
summary: Take-Two announced Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders for a November 19, 2026 launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard Edition is $79.99 and Ultimate Edition is $99.99. Digital pre-orders can pre-load starting November 12, 2026. Physical copies include a download code and go on sale that same day.
